messages:
zoe: quick usability session notes. We tested the new latency dashboard compact layout with 6 PMs. Main takeaway: sampling control discoverability still an issue for first-time users.
mike: did they miss it because it's inline or because the label is subtle?
zoe: both. several said 'where's the sampling setting' and looked in the filter menu. We should add a subtle pulsing hint on first load that points to 'Sampling • 100%'.
anya: pulse is ok but we need a clear way to dismiss or it becomes noise. Maybe only show it once per user per dashboard.
ying: accessibility check: make sure the pulsing animation respects 'prefers-reduced-motion'. Also ensure screen readers announce 'sampling control available' when the dashboard initially loads.
zoe: participants liked the new 'why p95?' info popup. One PM suggested adding a short visual example (two short bars showing p95 vs median) inside the popup.
mike: love that. keeps it concrete.
anya: copy tweak: change 'Why p95?' popup header to 'Why we track the 95th percentile' — clearer for external audiences.
zoe: another note: heatmap colorblindness test failed for one participant using protanopia simulator. Need to run with safe palette (Viridis or ColorBrewer qualitative?)
ying: propose Viridis or a colorblind-safe sequential palette. I'll attach WCAG-friendly hexes.
mike: regarding time picker, folks wanted a 'recent anomaly' quick link that sets the time window to the last alert window. Is that product-y or ok for design to add?
anya: product ok'd the 'Jump to last anomaly' action. We'll add a small bell icon next to presets that opens a menu.
zoe: final: add a keyboard flow doc for the new drawer and sampling control. I'll draft steps for QA.
design-bot: research-notes uploaded by zoe.
zoe: tagging eng/sre for color palette and animaion accessibility PRs.
